title: JS Obfuscator configuration (.obfuscatorrc.json)
description: javascript-obfuscator options for this folder and its subfolders. They override the jsObfuscator.* settings.

preset.description: Base preset; the options in this file are applied on top of it. Overrides the jsObfuscator.preset setting.

optionsPreset.description: javascript-obfuscator preset name, accepted as an alternative to "preset".

advertisement.description: Print the JavaScript Obfuscator Pro advert to the console. Turned off by this extension.

compact.description: Write the output on a single line.

controlFlowFlattening.description: Restructure the code flow so it is harder to follow. Noticeably slows the code down.

controlFlowFlatteningThreshold.description: Fraction (0 to 1) of code affected by control-flow flattening.

deadCodeInjection.description: Insert blocks of code that never run. Greatly increases output size.

deadCodeInjectionThreshold.description: Fraction (0 to 1) of code affected by dead-code injection.

debugProtection.description: Make browser developer tools hard to use on the code.

debugProtectionInterval.description: Milliseconds between debug-protection checks; 0 disables the interval. Needs debugProtection.

disableConsoleOutput.description: Replace console.log, console.warn and the other console methods with empty functions.

domainLock.description: Only let the code run on these domains (a leading dot includes subdomains).

domainLockRedirectUrl.description: Where the browser is sent if the code runs on a domain not listed in domainLock.

forceTransformStrings.description: Strings (or regular expressions matching strings) that are always transformed, whatever stringArrayThreshold says.

identifierNamesCache.description: Name mapping shared between runs so separately obfuscated files agree on global names. null disables it.

identifierNamesGenerator.description: Style of new names: hexadecimal (_0xab12cd), mangled (a, b, c), mangled-shuffled, or dictionary (from identifiersDictionary).

identifiersPrefix.description: Prefix added to every renamed global identifier.

identifiersDictionary.description: Names used by the dictionary identifier names generator.

ignoreImports.description: Leave the module paths in require() and import() calls untransformed.

inputFileName.description: Name of the source file, used in source maps.

log.description: Log obfuscation details to the console.

numbersToExpressions.description: Replace number literals with equivalent arithmetic expressions.

renameGlobals.description: Also rename global variables and functions. Breaks code in other files (or around a selection) that uses them by name.

renameProperties.description: Rename object property names. Can break code; test the output carefully.

renamePropertiesMode.description: safe skips properties that are risky to rename; unsafe renames everything it can.

reservedNames.description: Regular expressions; identifiers matching any of them are never renamed.

reservedStrings.description: Regular expressions; strings matching any of them are never transformed.

stringArrayRotate.description: Rotate the string array by a random amount.

seed.description: Random seed. The same seed and input give the same output; 0 picks a random seed each run.

selfDefending.description: Make the code stop working if it is reformatted or beautified. Do not modify the output afterwards.

stringArrayShuffle.description: Shuffle the items in the string array.

simplify.description: Simplify code while obfuscating, giving shorter expressions.

sourceMap.description: Generate a source map. Only sourceMapMode "inline" is useful here: this extension does not write separate .map files.

sourceMapBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the source map comment when sourceMapMode is "separate".

sourceMapFileName.description: File name for the source map comment when sourceMapMode is "separate".

sourceMapMode.description: inline embeds the source map in the output; separate refers to a .map file.

sourceMapSourcesMode.description: Whether the source map embeds the original sources (sources-content) or only their names (sources).

splitStrings.description: Split string literals into chunks of splitStringsChunkLength characters.

stringArray.description: Move string literals into a shared array and replace them with lookups.

stringArrayCallsTransform.description: Also obfuscate the calls that read from the string array.

stringArrayCallsTransformThreshold.description: Fraction (0 to 1) of string array calls transformed by stringArrayCallsTransform.

stringArrayEncoding.description: How strings in the string array are encoded: none, base64, or rc4 (slower). With several values, each string gets one at random.

stringArrayIndexesType.description: Number format of the indexes into the string array.

stringArrayIndexShift.description: Add a random shift to string array indexes.

stringArrayWrappersChainedCalls.description: Let string array wrappers call each other.

stringArrayWrappersCount.description: Number of string array wrappers per scope.

stringArrayWrappersParametersMaxCount.description: Maximum number of parameters of function-type string array wrappers.

stringArrayWrappersType.description: Whether string array wrappers are variables or functions.

stringArrayThreshold.description: Fraction (0 to 1) of string literals moved into the string array.

target.description: Where the code runs: browser, browser-no-eval (no eval-based helpers), node, or service-worker.

transformObjectKeys.description: Obfuscate the keys of object literals.

unicodeEscapeSequence.description: Write strings as unicode escape sequences. Greatly increases output size.
